{{Quote|Maze, I'm amazed his orders weren't to kill the Jedi, given what happened to him at Galidraan.|[[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]], to [[Maze (clone trooper)|Maze]]|<ref name="Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
'''Galidraan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of snow-capped [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] and large pine forests, and was controlled by a [[Governor of Galidraan|planetary governor]], who resided in an opulent castle in the midst of a forest.

==History==
Galidraan was absorbed into [[Xim's empire|Xim's Empire]] as [[Xim/Legends|he]] expanded his borders from the [[Kingdom of Cron]] circa [[25,126 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> After the fall of the empire in [[25,100 BBY]], it would eventually join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

Twenty-two years before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and the [[True Mandalorians]] were hired to put down an insurrection on the planet Galidraan. After the rebels were defeated, the [[Governor of Galidraan]] (with his ally [[Tor Vizsla|Tor Viszla]], the leader of [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]]) framed the True Mandalorians for murdering "political activists" and begged the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to come stop them.

The [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] sent a [[Jedi task force|task force]] led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Komari Vosa]], who killed all but two Mandalorians (Jango Fett and [[Silas (Mandalorian)|Silas]]) during the [[Battle of Galidraan]]. Fett himself killed six Jedi with his bare hands. The Jedi would later discover they had been tricked into slaughtering the True Mandalorians by the governor.

In the aftermath of the battle, Fett was sold into slavery. He escaped [[42 BBY/Legends|two years later]], at which point he returned to Galidraan to reclaim his armor.

After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], Galidraan was soon absorbed into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
